item.title: MCK Deplores Alleged Pollution of Seaway
item.description: Following reports of lead and sulfate allegedly being dumped into the St. Lawrence River by a nearby recycling company, the Mohawk Council of Kahnawà:ke (MCK) released a statement expressing its concerns about pollution in the Seaway. item.title: Fatal Shooting in Kahnawake
item.description: The Kahnawà:ke Peacekeepers (PKs) are investigating a fatal shooting involving a non-local that occurred on the afternoon of January 20, 2026. item.title: Registration Open for $500 Inflation Benefit
item.description: Registration is now open for the Mohawk Council of Kahnawà:ke (MCK)’s one-time, $500 inflation benefit. The initiative was announced on January 6, 2026, and will provide every member on the Kahnawà:ke Kanien’kehá:ka Registry (aged 18 or older) with a $500 payment.
